static_traits.name: Li Jing
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and two siblings
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;既往without类似问题;not yet接受其他心理治疗或Intervention
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous but willing to cooperate; able to describe situations and automatic thoughts concretely; tone tends to be negative, with a skeptical attitude; expression clear, able to follow the counselor's guidance

basic_info.main_problem: 我总觉得人们在看我,评判我的外貌,导致我频繁照镜并not断检查自己的形象.
basic_info.core_demands: The thoughts about appearance and being judged continually affect confidence and daily functioning; hoping to relieve the excessive attention to appearance and the feeling of being judged.

core_beliefs: do not人总在注视并评判我

special_situations.event: After starting a new job, a colleague comments on her clothing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If someone comments on my clothing, it means I look terrible and others will see me the same way
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles attention to appearance and frequently looks in the mirror, trying to make oneself look 'more perfect' to avoid being evaluated again

special_situations.event: When walking into the company break room, feels everyone is staring at her
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人看我,就一定是在负面评判我的外貌
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Secretly checks her appearance in windows or any reflective surface and adjusts her grooming
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are scrutinizing me, thinking I look terrible

special_situations.event: In work or social settings, frequently notices others' gazes or casual comments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的外表not够完美,就会被人批评或排斥
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复检查外貌,尝试回避镜子,use自我肯定语但效果有限
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我看起来not够好,会被人看not起

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and receive positive evaluations
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate,被羞辱与被负面审视
defense_goal: 通过持续Self-monitoring与让外表看起来更'完美'来降低被批评的可能性

object_relations.self_representation: A scrutinized person being evaluated, easily humiliated
object_relations.object_representation: Picky, critical others (especially colleagues / the public)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests recording and restructuring negative automatic thoughts and proposes trying new strategies
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这些方法可能只是理论,not一定能帮助自己(对改变持怀疑)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以委婉,犹疑的语气表达'not确定/可能not用',use模糊词汇(如'也许''好像')弱化承诺,减少情感暴露.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: In counseling, talks about others' gazes or comments, recalls social scenes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把内在的自我批评体验视为来自他人('他们都在看not起我')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 强调他人的负面意图与看法,use确定性措辞(如'他们都在...'),Reinforcement外界的批评感受.

manifestations: 有一位亲密朋友可倾诉但尚not yet表达困扰,倾向独自承受
Feels scrutinized and judged in public, reducing open communication

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept in themselves to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language expressions include: 'He is looking down on me' and 'They want to exclude me'.
manifestations: Believes everyone is negatively judging one's appearance
Attributing the self-criticism experience to others' gazes and comments

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection与过多的自我限制和苛责,对接触过于小心谨慎,与'自主性'对应.
manifestations: Frequently checks mirrors and reflective surfaces for appearance
Even trying to avoid mirrors, still indulges in appearance worries

positive_force: 存在一位亲密朋友可提供支持(虽尚not yet求助)
Willing to try recording and restructuring thoughts, able to propose alternative perspectives
Actively seeks psychological counseling with clear motivation (hopes to improve daily functioning and confidence)
negative_force: 过度Self-monitoring与外貌检查,依赖外部评价
Significant cognitive biases (mind reading, overgeneralization, mental filtering)

target_behavior.behavior: 在Work与公共场合反复检查外貌(照镜,利用反射面自检),伴随显著Social anxiety
antecedent: Colleagues' comments on clothing after starting a new job
When entering a lounge or crowd setting, feels watched by others
Excessively focuses on others' gazes or casual comments in social or work settings
target_behavior.core_reason: 对他人目光与评论采用'读心'与'过度概括'的Interpretation,担心被负面评价而产生强烈Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 通过检查外貌来降低Anxiety并寻求外部确认与安全感
target_behavior.consequence: Work表现受损,Tense relationships with colleagues,日常自我照料与作息受影响
